chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, when he broke his fast, would say:
"O Allah, for You we fasted, and upon Your sustenance we have broken our fast. So accept it from us. The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward remains."

key_terms.أَفْطَرْنَا: we broke our fast; ending the daily fast at iftar
key_terms.الظَّمَأُ: the thirst; the physical hardship of fasting
key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; a direct invocation in supplication
key_terms.الْأَجْرُ: the reward; the enduring recompense with Allah
key_terms.الْعُرُوقُ: the veins; indicating bodily refreshment after iftar
key_terms.رِزْقِكَ: Your sustenance; the provision granted by Allah
key_terms.صُمْنَا: we fasted; referring to the act of sawm done for Allah
key_terms.فَتَقَبَّلْهُ: so accept it; a plea for divine acceptance of the act

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say when breaking his fast?
ai.summary: This hadith preserves a supplication recited by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم at the time of breaking the fast. It expresses sincerity in fasting for Allah, gratitude for His provision, and hope that the act will be accepted and rewarded.
